TICKET
# Module Development and Distribution: Prestashop deletes automatically src/Entity/index.php, but it does not recursively in subfolders

This issue affects Add-On Marketplace contributors who are starting adapting their modules to the new Symfony 6.4 layer, used by PS 9+.
My module uses many entities and splits them in subfolders.
In order to ship my package I had to go through validation that rejects my module because I needed to remove all the index.php files in Entity's subfolders. 
I think PS should recursively go through all the Entity's subfolders and wipe the encountered index.php files.
Or...change the validation rules for the Entity folder.

## Attendu
Since PS does not delete the index.php files inside Entity subfolders, but only the one in Entity folder,
this will cause a problem during Doctrine entities scan.
I would expect PS deletes all the indexes.php recursively.

## Étapes
Premise: you must have subfolders in Entity folder.
Create, install and activate a module having index.php in each Entity's subfolder.
Try to access the backoffice.
It will cause a 500 error, silently managed with a redirect to the frontend.

Now remove the index.php files in the Entity folder and subfolders.
Module will be rejected by validation process.
